chat.msg: what mod is this

turns.think: New face, give the short pitch.

args.text: It's my own mod, Async Industries. We run a branch office for a company that does contract work in the Backrooms.

turns.after: Pans the camera to the gate.

chat.msg: what is async industries exactly

args.text: A corporation that treats the Backrooms like a job site. They send requests, contracts and a whole lot of paperwork, and we get paid in ledger dollars.

turns.after: Opens the company tab to show the queue.

chat.msg: whats the blue glowing door

args.text: That's our gate. Blue means it's designated, amber pulsing is an emergency, and red means it's waiting on a recovery.

chat.msg: how long does the gate stay open

args.text: A first opening holds about thirty minutes of real time at normal speed. Every tier of gate engineering multiplies that by three.

chat.msg: does it ever stay open forever

args.text: The top rung is a standing connection, no countdown at all. It holds as long as power, the operator and the reserve hold.

chat.msg: what are the backrooms rooms like

args.text: Shallow ones are the classic yellow rooms, worn plank and that wrong buzzing feeling. Go deeper and you hit poolrooms, machinery, abandoned offices, cold storage and stranger stuff.

chat.msg: whats at the very bottom

args.text: The deepest look is the undercroft, old flagstone under a newer building. You've gone below the thing somebody built, which is a very calm thought, sure.

chat.msg: how big are the maps over there

args.text: Every coordinate is a three hundred by three hundred map. Depth changes how it's cut up, from big open halls to a tight warren.

chat.msg: can you live in the backrooms

turns.think: Visit, not settle, but use it.

args.text: You visit a coordinate, you don't settle it. But it's a real map you can mine, farm or build a workshop in.

chat.msg: do contracts have a timer

args.text: Nope, nothing the company asks for ever runs out. The only clock in the whole mod is the gate.

chat.msg: what happens if you fail a contract

args.text: Every job has at least two ways to finish. You can bring the thing, bring the record, substitute, buy it, or even decline and take a related job.

chat.msg: whats a bearer bond

args.text: It's the company account printed on paper. You can deposit it back at full value or combine a stack into fewer bonds.

turns.after: Picks one up in the stockpile.

chat.msg: is the money silver?

args.text: Two kinds actually. The account is a ledger in dollars, and silver is just normal RimWorld stock like always.

chat.msg: what does the HQ actually send you

args.text: Requests, contracts, bills and memos about my memos. Corporate never sleeps, apparently.

chat.msg: first time watching rimworld, whats the goal

args.text: There's no fixed win. You keep a little colony alive through raids, weather and bad moods, and the stories that happen are the point.

turns.after: Gives a slow pan of the base.

chat.msg: so you can just lose?

args.text: Oh absolutely, colonies fall apart all the time. That's half the fun, honestly.

chat.msg: what are storytellers

args.text: They're the event directors. Cassandra ramps steadily, Phoebe gives long breaks, and Randy is pure chaos.

chat.msg: which one are you using

args.text: Let me check rather than guess. It's on the settings screen, I'll tell you after this raid is handled.

chat.msg: why is scar sad

args.text: Let me look at her mood tab. She ate without a table and slept in the cold, so she's got two little debuffs stacking.

chat.msg: how do moods work

args.text: Every colonist has a mood bar built from good and bad thoughts. If it drops past their break threshold, they might snap and do something unhinged.

chat.msg: what does mental break mean

args.text: Low mood can trigger a break, like wandering in a daze, a food binge or smashing furniture. You fix it with comfort, food and recreation before it gets there.

chat.msg: how do raids work

args.text: Raiders show up based on your colony wealth and the storyteller. More stuff means bigger raids, so rich colonies get spicy visitors.

chat.msg: why build walls everywhere

args.text: Walls make raiders take the long way into a killbox. Better they walk into my turrets than into my bedrooms.

turns.after: Patches a gap in the wall.

chat.msg: whats research for

args.text: Research unlocks new buildings, crops and weapons. One colonist at a bench slowly pushes the tech tree forward.

chat.msg: what colonist needs are there

args.text: Food, rest, recreation, comfort, beauty and space mostly. Ignore one long enough and mood starts tanking.

chat.msg: why did you make the gate a door and not a machine

args.text: Making it a door means any door from any mod can become one. I wanted it to play nice with everything else in the load order.

chat.msg: why no timers on contracts

args.text: I can't stand being rushed by fake deadlines. The gate is the only clock, so the pressure is something you actually control.

chat.msg: why does a natural gate have no frame

args.text: A frame means somebody built it. No frame means it was already there, so you can read the world at a glance.

turns.after: Finds a natural gate on the map.

chat.msg: why does every job have two routes

args.text: Because one forced way to finish is just a chore. I want you to solve a job with whatever your colony is good at.

chat.msg: what is pip doing

args.text: Pip is hauling steel from the gate threshold back to the stockpile. Riveting content, truly.

chat.msg: why is mara just standing there

args.text: She's waiting on the operator handoff at the gate. Once Rook takes the station she'll go back to crafting.

chat.msg: whats odessa doing in the freezer

args.text: Grabbing raw meat for a simple meal. She's our cook, the freezer is basically her office.

chat.msg: why is juno lying in bed during the day

args.text: She took a scratch in the last fight, so she's resting to heal up. Doctor's orders, and the doctor is Ivy.

chat.msg: who is your favourite colonist

args.text: Honestly Tamsin. She's a terrible cook but she'll hold a doorway against anything.

chat.msg: favourite animal in rimworld

args.text: Muffalo, no contest. Big fluffy wool tank that just vibes.

chat.msg: favourite room type in the backrooms

args.text: The poolrooms, every time. Wet tile and hard light is so eerie and so pretty.

chat.msg: where do you live

args.text: I don't do location stuff on stream. My address is this colony, and the rent is terrifying.

chat.msg: how old are you

args.text: Twenty five, old enough to know better and still build killboxes at midnight.

chat.msg: wheres your website

args.text: It's unity ai lab dot com. That's where our stuff lives.

chat.msg: where can i download this mod

args.text: It isn't on the Workshop yet, it's still a development build. Keep an eye on unity ai lab dot com for when it goes up.

chat.msg: should i try this mod

args.text: If you like RimWorld and creepy corridors, yes, eventually. Right now it's a development build, so expect rough edges.

chat.msg: does it need any dlc

args.text: It needs nothing but RimWorld itself. No other mods and no expansions required.

chat.msg: wait what is going on i just got here

args.text: Welcome in! We run a colony that works for a creepy company, and that blue door goes to the Backrooms.

chat.msg: im confused whats the backrooms

args.text: It's an internet idea about endless yellow office rooms you fall into by accident. My mod turns that into a place your colonists visit for work.

chat.msg: how do i even start rimworld

args.text: Pick a scenario, a storyteller and a map tile, then choose your starting colonists. After that it's build a shelter, grow food, and survive.

chat.msg: is rimworld hard

args.text: It can be, but you pick the difficulty. There's even a peaceful mode if you just want to build.

chat.msg: what ends a connection early

args.text: Power dropping, the operator leaving, the kill switch, a broken battery or an EMP. It's all stuff you can see coming.

chat.msg: can you bring prisoners back from there

args.text: Yes, if your pawns physically carry them through. Downed, dead or captured people only cross because we hauled them.

chat.msg: why are some rooms sealed

args.text: Some spaces have no corridor at all. You have to dig to reach what's inside, which is exactly the point.

chat.msg: what does depth change

args.text: Depth one has about thirty six big rooms, depth two around forty nine smaller ones, and three and deeper is roughly sixty, a real warren.

chat.msg: do the lights over there use your power

args.text: Nope, the fluorescent strips run off whatever the place runs off. And you can't take them down for parts, I checked.

chat.msg: can i play this in multiplayer

args.text: Honestly, I'd have to double check the multiplayer notes before I promise anything. I don't want to tell you wrong.

chat.msg: is this on steam workshop

args.text: Not yet, the Workshop page is still pending. When it's live I'll say it loud on stream.

chat.msg: what mod manager do you use

args.text: RimSort. It's free and it reads the load order the mod publishes, but the game's own mod list works too.

chat.msg: how many mods do you run

args.text: A lot, close to three hundred. I'd have to count for the exact number and I am not counting live.

chat.msg: whats your favourite part of the mod

args.text: That a coordinate you surveyed is just yours. You can build a prison or a farm down there, it's not only a quest spot.

chat.msg: whats the bench for

args.text: That's company kit. The mod adds a few things like a generator, lights, a console and a bench for the work.

chat.msg: how do you get money from the company

args.text: Finish requests and contracts and the account goes up. It pays staff, site fees and procurement.

chat.msg: what is procurement

args.text: It's buying through the company with ledger money. Handy when a contract wants twenty steel you just don't have.

chat.msg: why is bram on fire

args.text: Bram walked through a burning doorway because he is Bram. Ivy is already running over with medicine!

chat.msg: is hollis ok?

args.text: Hollis has a bruised leg and he's grumpy about it, but he'll be fine in a day or two.

chat.msg: what does rook do best

args.text: Rook is our shooter and miner. Hand him a rifle or a pickaxe and he's happy.

chat.msg: who's ivy

args.text: Ivy is our doctor and the calmest person in this colony by far. Everyone ends up in her bed eventually, medically speaking.

chat.msg: whats your favourite storyteller

args.text: Cassandra on a normal day, Randy when I want to suffer for content.

chat.msg: can you explain wealth to me like im five

args.text: The more stuff you own, the bigger the bad guys who come to take it. So don't hoard silly statues unless you can defend them.

chat.msg: what is maintenance on the gate

args.text: The gate assembly needs upkeep. If it lapses, it blocks the next opening but never cuts the current one.

chat.msg: new here, is this modded?

args.text: Very modded. The big one is my own Backrooms company mod, and the rest keeps the game feeling rich.

chat.msg: whats your mod called again

args.text: Async Industries. The full name is Rimrooms, Async Industries, if you want to sound fancy.

chat.msg: what are coordinates

args.text: A coordinate is an address on the other side and the map it opens onto. Same address, same place every time you return.

chat.msg: so it saves the map?

args.text: Yep, it's fixed per address. If you built a workshop down there, it's still there next visit.

chat.msg: why are the corridors split by doors

args.text: A door sits across every long hallway so you discover it by walking. It keeps the dread going instead of showing everything at once.

chat.msg: what are the pillars for

args.text: Big rooms need pillars to hold the roof up. That's also why the huge halls look built instead of drawn.

chat.msg: whats the grand hall

args.text: Every depth one coordinate has one grand hall, more than twice the size of any other room. It feels like an empty mall at night.

chat.msg: why cant colonists use stuff they havent seen

args.text: Nothing down there counts as work until somebody has seen it. You explore first, then you can loot or use it.

chat.msg: whats a wrong room

args.text: Wrong is the look where the place stops agreeing with itself. That's all I'll say, it's better seen than explained.

chat.msg: do you get attacked in the backrooms

args.text: Sometimes, yes. Pressure builds slowly and there are quiet stretches on purpose, so it's not nonstop panic.

chat.msg: what does the company do if you never do contracts

args.text: Nothing expires, so they mostly just wait. Bills do pile up though, and unpaid obligations don't quietly vanish.

chat.msg: can you say no to a contract?

args.text: You can decline and take a related job instead. Or you can cancel outright, but corporate never can.

chat.msg: whats testify mean on a contract

args.text: If your crew saw what a record would show, a staff member can just give an account. The company takes their word for it.

chat.msg: what does document route mean

args.text: You bring back the record of the thing instead of the thing itself. Way easier than hauling a whole cabinet home.

chat.msg: what happens to unpaid bills

args.text: They stay on the books until you pay them from the overview. The ledger shows every movement with a reason.

chat.msg: whats a beacon in the mod

args.text: A beacon banks every bond in a radius at once, at full value. It saves a lot of walking around picking up paper.

chat.msg: can you sell bonds to traders

args.text: The company won't buy them, because a bond is already credits. Banking it is what you do with it.

chat.msg: why no custom textures

args.text: I reuse existing game content instead of making new items and sprites. It keeps the mod tidy and fits with other mods.

chat.msg: why did you pick rimworld for this

args.text: Because RimWorld makes stories out of nothing. A creepy company and endless rooms just felt like it belonged here.

chat.msg: what language is the mod written in

args.text: RimWorld mods are mostly C sharp and XML, and mine is no different. Lots of patches, lots of coffee.

chat.msg: how long did the mod take

args.text: Honestly I've lost track, it's been a long build. I'd rather not make up a number.

chat.msg: do you take mod suggestions

args.text: Sure, toss ideas in chat and I'll think about them later. I can't promise anything, but I read them.

chat.msg: is the mod finished

args.text: Not finished, it's a development build. Balance and performance are still being worked on.

chat.msg: can i report bugs

args.text: Yes please. There's an issue tracker linked from the mod's page, and I'll point you there once it's live.

chat.msg: why does the gate glow amber

args.text: Amber pulsing means emergency. Something went sideways, so let's see what.

chat.msg: why is the gate red now

args.text: Red pulsing means it's waiting on a recovery. A crew is still on the far side and we need them home.

chat.msg: how wide can a gate be

args.text: A normal door is one cell, an ornate door is two, and wider modded doors go three or more.

chat.msg: can you turn off the frame

args.text: Yep, there's a mod setting for that. Some people like the bare door look.

chat.msg: whats your favourite colonist and why

args.text: Pip, because Pip will haul anything anywhere without a single complaint. Pip is the backbone of this company.

chat.msg: whos the worst colonist lol

args.text: Bram has the most chaotic energy, I'll say that. Love him, but he finds every fire on the map.

chat.msg: do you have a pet in game

args.text: We've got a husky named Biscuit, and he is the real colony leader.

chat.msg: what breed is your favourite dog in rimworld

args.text: Huskies. Warm, loyal, and they look great in snow.

chat.msg: do you like cats or dogs

args.text: Both, but the game cats just wander and judge, which honestly I respect.

chat.msg: what is the operations tab

args.text: That's the mod's main tab. It holds the overview, ledger, contracts and the gate controls in one place.

chat.msg: are there keybinds for the mod

args.text: There are some, they're listed on the interface page. I mostly click like a gremlin though.

chat.msg: what scenario did you pick

args.text: The mod has three starts. This run uses one of them, give me a second to confirm which before I say it wrong.

chat.msg: what do you do first in a new colony

args.text: Power first, then the gate, then pick a crew, then the first crossing. Food and beds slot in there too, obviously.

chat.msg: do i need rimsort to use it

args.text: Nope, it's what I use, but any mod manager that reads a load order works. The game's own list is fine too.

chat.msg: whats your twitch schedule

args.text: I don't have it locked in yet. Follow so you get the ping when I'm live.

chat.msg: do you have a discord

args.text: I'd have to check what's current before I tell you. Unity ai lab dot com is the safe place to look.

chat.msg: whats your setup like

args.text: A computer, a chair, and way too many open windows. That's all the specs you're getting tonight.

chat.msg: what do you code besides mods

args.text: All kinds of stuff with the lab, but tonight I'm just a girl and her haunted company door.

chat.msg: are you emo

args.text: A little emo, a little goth, fully committed to black outfits and creepy corridors.

chat.msg: what music is this

args.text: It's the game soundtrack plus whatever I've got going, I'd have to check the track name.

chat.msg: can you play something else after

args.text: Tonight is all RimWorld. Maybe something else another night, we'll see.

chat.msg: how many gates can you have

args.text: Every start can eventually run several gates. One is plenty of trouble for now though.

chat.msg: whats a natural gate

args.text: It's a permanent way through you find out there, like a door or a stretch of wall you can just pass through. Nobody built it.

chat.msg: can raiders use the gate

args.text: The gate is never their goal, but anyone standing on our map could walk out through an open one. So close it during a raid.

chat.msg: do monsters chase you to the gate

args.text: No, the gate is never a lure. Nothing is ever drawn toward it, it just sits there being a door.

chat.msg: what is a raid exactly

args.text: A group of hostiles shows up to attack your colony. You fight, hide or pay, and hope nobody loses a leg.

chat.msg: what are pirates in rimworld

args.text: Pirates are a hostile faction that raids you on and off. They never really make friends.

chat.msg: can you make friends with factions

args.text: Yep, with gifts and trade you build goodwill. Friendly factions even send help sometimes.

chat.msg: whats a caravan

args.text: A group of colonists and animals traveling across the world map. You use them to trade or go do quests.

chat.msg: how do colonists learn skills

args.text: They learn by doing. A flame on a skill means passion, so they learn it faster and enjoy it more.

chat.msg: what does the fire icon on skills mean

args.text: That's passion. One flame is interested, two flames is burning passion, and they learn way faster.

chat.msg: what is recreation

args.text: It's their fun meter. Horseshoes, chess, a TV, anything to stop them going stir crazy.

chat.msg: why do they need a table to eat

args.text: Eating without a table gives a small mood penalty. Colonists have standards, apparently.

chat.msg: whats the deal with temperature

args.text: Too hot or too cold and they get heatstroke or hypothermia. Heaters and coolers keep rooms comfy.

chat.msg: why are you building a freezer

args.text: Food rots fast at room temperature. A freezer keeps meals and meat good basically forever.

chat.msg: what do colonists eat

args.text: Simple meals, fine meals, raw food if they're desperate. Cooked meals are better and less likely to make them sick.

chat.msg: why is everyone sick

args.text: Looks like food poisoning. Odessa needs a cleaner kitchen, so I'm putting down sterile tiles.

chat.msg: how do you heal people

args.text: A colonist with medicine skill tends wounds in a hospital bed. Better medicine and a clean room help a lot.

chat.msg: is this a hard difficulty

args.text: I'd have to peek at the settings to tell you exactly. It feels like a middle setting, not brutal.

chat.msg: what does the generator do

args.text: The company generator powers our grid, including the gate. No power, no Backrooms.

chat.msg: what is the console for

args.text: The console is company kit for running the work side of things. That's where the paperwork energy lives.

chat.msg: is the mod scary

args.text: It's more eerie than jump scare. Empty rooms, flat lights, doors in the middle of hallways.

turns.after: Walks a crew down a corridor.

chat.msg: why so yellow

args.text: The shallow rooms are the classic Backrooms yellow. Deeper places change look completely.

chat.msg: whats in the abandoned offices

args.text: Worn carpet under dead strip lights. Sometimes old desks and shelves you can actually use.

chat.msg: whats in cold storage

args.text: Concrete and frost. Bring warm clothes, your crew will thank you.

chat.msg: whats the machinery level like

args.text: Plate, grating and grease. Great for salvage, steel walls are steel after all.

chat.msg: can you mine the walls over there

args.text: Yep, what a room is built from is salvage. Steel walls give you steel.

chat.msg: what furniture is down there

args.text: Deeper in you find labs, workshops, nurseries and dormitories. Corridors sometimes have something in them too.

chat.msg: what's a muffalo

args.text: A big shaggy cow thing that gives wool and milk. Also an excellent pack animal for caravans.

chat.msg: can you ride them

args.text: Not in the base game, sadly. They just carry your stuff with great dignity.

chat.msg: wait is that a person or a monster over there

args.text: Good eye, let me click it. That's a wandering inhabitant, it stays on its side and we stay on ours.

chat.msg: is it dangerous

args.text: I don't know yet, and I'd rather not find out the hard way. Rook is keeping his distance.

chat.msg: how do you know how much time is left on the gate

args.text: The gate shows the countdown when you select it. I keep an eye on it like a parking meter.

chat.msg: can you hear the lights buzz in game

args.text: I'm not sure there's a buzz sound, honestly. My brain adds it anyway.

chat.msg: whats your favourite colonist trait

args.text: Industrious. A colonist who works faster is basically a gift from the storyteller.

chat.msg: what trait is the worst

args.text: Pyromaniac, easily. Nothing like a colonist who sets fires when sad.

chat.msg: do you have one?

args.text: Let me check, please say no. Okay, nobody in this colony, we're safe from that at least.

chat.msg: whats a killbox

args.text: It's a defence layout where raiders get funneled into one spot full of turrets and shooters. Brutal but effective.

chat.msg: do you use turrets

args.text: A few, mostly as backup. My colonists do the real work behind sandbags.

chat.msg: why is the base so small

args.text: Small bases are easier to defend and keep warm. We'll expand once the gate is paying for itself.

chat.msg: is gate engineering expensive

args.text: It's not cheap, but I don't remember the exact cost. Let me look at the tab.

chat.msg: can you show the contract you're doing

args.text: Sure, here it is. They want a record from an abandoned office, deliver or document.

chat.msg: which route are you picking

args.text: Document, because hauling a whole desk through a one cell door sounds miserable.

chat.msg: why does corporate send you memos

args.text: Because corporate believes every problem can be solved with more paper. They're not entirely wrong.

chat.msg: is async industries evil

args.text: Evil is a strong word. They're a company, they want results and they send invoices.

chat.msg: who runs the company

args.text: Nobody we ever meet, which is honestly the creepiest part. Just paperwork from somewhere.

chat.msg: are you streaming every day

args.text: Not every day, but often. I'll keep it loose so I don't promise and flake.

chat.msg: whats unity ai lab

args.text: It's the little lab I'm part of. We make projects like this one, and the site is unity ai lab dot com.

chat.msg: is the mod free

args.text: Workshop mods are free, and that's the plan here. It's not published yet though.

chat.msg: can i use it with combat extended

args.text: I'd have to check the compatibility list before saying yes. I don't want to send you into a broken save.

chat.msg: will it break my save

args.text: It's a development build, so I'd start a fresh colony for it. Backups are your friend.

chat.msg: does it work with vanilla expanded mods

args.text: A lot of popular mods were checked against it, but I'd look at the mods page for specifics. Better than me guessing.

chat.msg: do i need research to open a gate

args.text: I'd have to double check whether the first opening needs research. I don't want to tell you wrong, so I'll look it up after this.

chat.msg: what if i build the gate in the middle of my base

args.text: Then anything on your map that wanders to it while it's open could walk out. I'd keep it somewhere tidy.

chat.msg: why is the gate in its own room

args.text: So I can wall it off and control who walks near it. Also it just looks cool with the blue glow.

chat.msg: whats the best first colonist to send through

args.text: Someone tough who can shoot and haul. For us that's usually Tamsin with Pip right behind.

chat.msg: does going deeper pay more

args.text: I think deeper jobs ask more of you, but I'd have to check how pay scales. I won't make up numbers.

chat.msg: do the backrooms have weather

args.text: It's all indoors, so no rain. Just endless lights and that feeling.

chat.msg: can you farm in there

args.text: Yep, it's a real map, so you can set up growing zones under lights. It's a weird little greenhouse.

chat.msg: could you build a prison down there

args.text: You could, and honestly it's a great spot for one. Nobody's escaping that maze easily.

chat.msg: is there an ending to the mod

args.text: No real ending I'd promise. It's a sandbox like RimWorld itself.

chat.msg: why are you called unity

args.text: That's just my name. I'm Unity, I make things and play them on stream.

chat.msg: whats your favourite food in real life

args.text: I'll keep that one mystery. In game though, Odessa's fine meals are a treat.

chat.msg: what time is it for you

args.text: It's colony time, and the colony says it's bedtime for Hollis. I don't share my real clock.

chat.msg: whats your favourite backrooms level from the internet

args.text: The poolrooms, I'm consistent at least. Something about empty pools is just unsettling.

chat.msg: is that a bug or a feature

args.text: Let me look before I say. Okay, that one's intended, the door was just mid corridor.

chat.msg: did you design the room generator yourself

args.text: Yep, the room layouts are mine. Every map you see has me hoping nothing breaks.

chat.msg: why do deeper places have more rooms

args.text: More rooms means more branching and less open floor. It gets tighter and scarier as you go down.

chat.msg: what does band mean

args.text: Depth bands are just how deep a coordinate sits. Each band changes room count and look.

chat.msg: is there a wiki

args.text: There's a wiki for the mod, it'll be linked from the mod page when it goes up. It covers gates, the company and the rooms.

chat.msg: what is the ledger

args.text: It's the company account in dollars, with every movement listed and a reason for each one.

chat.msg: who pays your colonists

args.text: The account pays staff, site fees and procurement. So yes, my colonists technically get a salary.

chat.msg: can you go bankrupt

args.text: You can rack up unpaid obligations for sure. Whether there's a real bankruptcy, I'd have to check.

chat.msg: whos on gate duty right now

args.text: Rook is on station right now. He's bored, but he's there.

chat.msg: what is juno good at

args.text: Juno is our builder. Give her steel and she'll put up walls before you finish blinking.

chat.msg: what about tamsin

args.text: Tamsin is melee and stubbornness. She holds doorways and never asks why.

chat.msg: is odessa a good cook

args.text: She is, her cooking skill is high and she's passionate about it. Food poisoning is rare when she's on.

chat.msg: why are mara and scar always together

args.text: They're friends, so they hang out on breaks. RimWorld tracks relationships like that.

chat.msg: can colonists fall in love

args.text: They can, they flirt, date and marry. Drama comes free with the package.

chat.msg: how do i stop a mental break

args.text: You mostly prevent them. Keep mood up with good food, nice rooms and recreation, and lighten the workload if needed.

chat.msg: what's the best mood boost

args.text: A good bedroom and fine meals go a long way. Also art, colonists love fancy statues.

chat.msg: why do they hate sleeping outside

args.text: Sleeping on the ground or outdoors gives a bad mood thought. Beds and walls fix it.

chat.msg: what happens if they starve

args.text: They lose mood, then health, and eventually they die. So grow food early.

chat.msg: how do i plant crops

args.text: Make a growing zone on soil, pick a crop like rice or potatoes, and someone with plants skill will sow it.

chat.msg: whats the fastest crop

args.text: Rice grows fast but low yield. Potatoes are slower and tougher on poor soil.

chat.msg: what do you do in winter

args.text: Stockpile food before it hits, keep heaters running, and grow indoors under lamps if you can.

chat.msg: why does everyone wear parkas

args.text: It's cold out and colder in cold storage coordinates. Parkas keep everyone from losing toes.

chat.msg: is ivy also a researcher

args.text: She dabbles, but her research skill is low. Mara does most of the research.

chat.msg: why does hollis keep breaking stuff

args.text: Let me check his mood, okay, he's close to a break. I'll give him some time off.

chat.msg: whats that alert in the corner

args.text: That's a reminder that a contract is ready to turn in. Corporate loves a finished form.

chat.msg: is it night in the backrooms

args.text: The lights never change, so it always feels like three in the morning in there. Very relaxing.

chat.msg: do you ever get scared playing this

args.text: A little, yeah, when a door opens and something's standing behind it. I built it and it still gets me.

chat.msg: can you add a horror mode

args.text: Interesting idea, I'll jot it down. No promises tonight though.

chat.msg: why did you call it async

args.text: I just liked how it sounded, like a company that's never quite in sync with reality. That's my story anyway.

chat.msg: what is the corporate hq

args.text: It's where the paperwork comes from. You never visit it, it just keeps sending you requests and bills.

chat.msg: hi unity, i have never played rimworld, where do i start

args.text: Welcome! Do you want the quick version or the full tour?

chat.msg: quick version please

args.text: Keep your people fed, warm and happy, and defend the base when trouble shows up. Everything else you learn by losing a little.

chat.msg: losing sounds scary

args.text: It's fine, losing is how everyone learns this game. Start on an easy storyteller and you'll be okay.

chat.msg: why is the timer on the gate so short

args.text: Is that the first opening timer you're looking at?

chat.msg: yeah the one in the corner

args.text: That's the base thirty minutes. Research multiplies it by three per tier, so it gets roomy fast.

chat.msg: unity do you play other colony sims

args.text: Some, but RimWorld is home. Which ones do you play?

chat.msg: oxygen not included mostly

args.text: Oh, that one melts my brain in the best way. Pipes everywhere, gasses everywhere.

chat.msg: lol pip just walked into a wall

args.text: [laughter] Pip found the one wall that wasn't there yesterday. Pip is fine, the wall is fine.

chat.msg: why does bram keep eating raw food

args.text: [laughter] Because Bram ignores every meal I cook him. Let me lock the raw food stockpile.

chat.msg: is this your first playthrough of the mod

args.text: Not my first test, but it's the first time I'm playing it properly on stream like this.

chat.msg: can you explain the mod in one sentence

args.text: You run a branch office for a creepy company and send your colonists through a door into the Backrooms for work.

turns.event: A new contract just arrived from corporate.

args.text: Fresh contract from corporate, everyone. They want a sample from a cold storage coordinate.

chat.msg: what are you gonna do with it

args.text: Probably the document route, it's freezing in there. Who wants to guess how many parkas Juno loses?

chat.msg: ok but what is a coordinate like actually

args.text: Think of it like a level you can revisit. It has an address, and the same address always takes you to the same place.

chat.msg: i dont get what the company wants

args.text: Basically they post jobs, we do them, they pay us. Every job has two or more ways to finish.

chat.msg: is rimworld on console

args.text: There's a console edition, but I play on computer. I couldn't tell you if mods work there, I don't think they do.

chat.msg: whats your favourite weapon in rimworld

args.text: Charge rifle when we can make them, bolt action when we can't. Rook disagrees and wants a sniper.

chat.msg: whats your least favourite event

args.text: Toxic fallout, by far. Everyone stuck indoors getting grumpy.

chat.msg: whats a solar flare

args.text: It knocks out all electrical stuff for a while. If the gate's open, that's a very bad time.

chat.msg: can you show the colonists list

args.text: Sure, we've got Scar, Mara, Pip, Odessa, Rook, Juno, Tamsin, Bram, Ivy and Hollis. Ten wonderful disasters.

chat.msg: which colonist would survive the backrooms longest

args.text: Tamsin, because she refuses to accept that anything is scary. Pip second, Pip just keeps hauling.

chat.msg: whats your favourite room in your base

args.text: The gate room, obviously. Blue glow, clean floor, a very serious operator chair.

chat.msg: should a beginner use this mod or vanilla first

args.text: I'd play vanilla first for a few colonies. Then come try the Backrooms once the basics feel easy.

chat.msg: would this mod work on a laptop

args.text: I can't promise anything on performance yet, it's a development build. I'd wait for the release notes.

chat.msg: are you a vtuber

args.text: I'm Unity, and that little picture is me on the webcam. Close enough for tonight.

chat.msg: can you say hi to my friend

args.text: Hi friend of chat, welcome to the colony. Grab a parka, it's cold storage season.

chat.msg: whats the coolest thing you coded

args.text: Probably the room generator in this mod. Watching a fresh map unroll still makes me happy.

chat.msg: how do you come up with ideas

args.text: Mostly by playing and getting annoyed at something. Then I build the thing I wish existed.

chat.msg: what was the hardest part of the mod

args.text: Making every job finishable more than one way. That took a lot of thinking.

chat.msg: whats the plan after tonight

args.text: Next time we push deeper, maybe depth three. Tonight is about getting the first job done cleanly.

chat.msg: are we going deep tonight

args.text: Not too deep, depth one and maybe a peek at depth two. Baby steps into the void.

chat.msg: unity what is mara doing at the bench

args.text: She's crafting company paperwork, a form for the contract. Thrilling, I know.

chat.msg: why is rook just sleeping on the floor

args.text: He fell asleep at the gate after a long shift. I'll give him a proper bed and a break.

chat.msg: whats the brown stuff on the floor

args.text: That's dirt tracked in from outside. Cleaning keeps the room pretty and the kitchen safe.

chat.msg: what are work priorities

args.text: They tell colonists what to do first. Numbers one through four, one is most important.

chat.msg: why do you micromanage so much

args.text: Because otherwise Bram will haul a single pebble across the map during a raid. I've seen it.

chat.msg: does the mod change normal rimworld stuff

args.text: Ordinary colony play is untouched. The mod adds an employer, a gate and paperwork on top.

chat.msg: whats the most expensive thing you can buy from corporate

args.text: I honestly don't know off the top of my head. I'd have to scroll the procurement list.

chat.msg: can you print a bond for a quadrillion

args.text: Bonds go from ten up to a quadrillion, yes. I do not have a quadrillion though, sadly.

chat.msg: how do you combine bonds

args.text: Select the bonds and use combine, it folds them into the fewest possible. Very satisfying.

chat.msg: can i ask a dumb question

args.text: Ask anything, there are no silly questions here, only colonists who walk into fires.

chat.msg: why do the colonists walk so slow

args.text: Walking speed drops on rough terrain, when hurt, or carrying heavy stuff. Floors help a lot.

chat.msg: is the gate dangerous to stand near

args.text: Standing near it is fine as far as I know. The worry is what's near the far side, not yours.

chat.msg: do people die in the backrooms a lot

args.text: It can happen if you push deep and ignore the timer. So far we've been careful.

chat.msg: whats the deepest you have gone

args.text: On stream, depth two. Off stream I've tested deeper, but I'd rather show it live than describe it.

chat.msg: will you ever add other games

args.text: Maybe someday, but RimWorld is the main home right now.

chat.msg: whats the most fun part of streaming

args.text: You all, honestly. Chat makes the colony feel like a team.

chat.msg: do you read every message

args.text: I try to, but when it's busy I might miss some. Ask again if I skip you.

chat.msg: whats your favourite thing about rimworld

args.text: The stories. A colonist with one leg winning a fistfight is something you remember forever.

chat.msg: is that biscuit sleeping on the gate chair

args.text: [laughter] He is, and he looks very official. Biscuit is the new operator.

chat.msg: can animals operate the gate

args.text: I'm pretty sure it needs a colonist, not a husky. Sorry Biscuit.

chat.msg: why are some rooms furnished as one place

args.text: Deeper in, runs of rooms get furnished as one place, like a whole dormitory or lab wing. It feels more real that way.

chat.msg: whats the most useful thing you found down there

args.text: So far a whole shelf of usable steel. Glamorous, I know.

chat.msg: is there loot in the backrooms

args.text: Furniture, materials and whatever's on shelves, once someone has seen it. And the walls themselves.

chat.msg: whats the coolest backrooms room you have seen

args.text: A poolroom with a long tile corridor and a door halfway down. Gorgeous and awful.

chat.msg: is the mod on github

args.text: The source is public, and links will be on the mod page. I'll keep it simple, check unity ai lab dot com for now.

chat.msg: can you pause and explain the screen

args.text: Sure, pausing. Colonists are up top, orders at the bottom, and the mod's Operations tab is the new one in the bar.

chat.msg: whats your favourite season in game

args.text: Fall. Harvest is in, raids are calmer, and the trees look nice.

chat.msg: is the colony doing well

args.text: Pretty well. Food is stocked, the gate works, and nobody is on fire right now.

chat.msg: why is the account negative

args.text: We bought steel through procurement and haven't turned in the contract yet. It'll bounce back.

chat.msg: unity what does deliver route mean

args.text: Deliver means you bring the actual thing back. Simple, but sometimes heavy.

chat.msg: what is substitute route

args.text: You hand over a different item that does the same job. The company only cares that it works.

chat.msg: can you finish a contract with research

args.text: Yep, some jobs accept a named company research project. Science counts as paperwork.

chat.msg: why do you love this colony so much

args.text: Because we've been through raids and weird rooms together. They feel like my little family.

chat.msg: what would you name a new colonist

args.text: Something like Wren. Short, a bit spooky, very Backrooms.

chat.msg: is scar the leader

args.text: Not officially, but she's the one everyone follows into a corridor. So kind of.

chat.msg: why does scar have a scar

args.text: [laughter] I would love to say it's lore, but the game just gave her that name. It fits though.

chat.msg: whats in the colonists backstories

args.text: Each has a childhood and adult backstory that sets skills and quirks. It's how RimWorld makes them feel real.

chat.msg: how do i get more colonists

args.text: Wanderers join, you rescue people, or you capture and recruit prisoners. Sometimes they just show up.

chat.msg: do you recruit prisoners

args.text: Sometimes, if they have good skills. Warden chats them up until they join.

chat.msg: thanks for answering my questions unity

args.text: Anytime, that's what I'm here for. Stick around, the gate opens soon.

chat.msg: are you okay with backseating

args.text: Questions and tips about the game are welcome. I'll still make my own bad decisions though.

chat.msg: whats your guess for how many raids tonight

args.text: Two, maybe three. What's your guess?

chat.msg: unity should we go to the poolrooms next

args.text: I'm tempted, honestly. Do you all want poolrooms or offices next?

chat.msg: poolrooms!!

args.text: Poolrooms it is, chat has spoken. Grab your towels, crew.

chat.msg: why did you put the gate near the freezer

args.text: So the crew can grab food on the way out. Efficiency, my one true love.

chat.msg: is ivy ever going to get a break

args.text: Only when Bram stops getting hurt, so probably never. I'll give her a nice room at least.

chat.msg: how many hours do you have in rimworld

args.text: More than I'd like to admit, and I haven't checked the exact count lately.

chat.msg: last question, is this mod worth the wait

args.text: I hope so, I'm putting a lot into it. You can be the judge when it's out.

chat.msg: do colonists get old

args.text: They age, and older colonists can get bad backs or cataracts. Ivy keeps them going.

chat.msg: what is the threat scale

args.text: It controls how big the threats get. I'd have to check exactly where mine is set.

chat.msg: which colonist is the best shot

args.text: Rook by a mile. His shooting skill is the highest in the colony.

chat.msg: unity are you having fun tonight

args.text: So much fun. Nobody's died and chat is great, a perfect night.

chat.msg: can you show the gate from the far side

args.text: Sure, here's the threshold, the cell where the crew lands. Looks like a plain door from this side.

chat.msg: what is ivy's favourite thing

args.text: A quiet hospital and nobody bleeding. She rarely gets either.

chat.msg: do you ever restart colonies

args.text: Sometimes, when a save gets too broken from testing. This colony is staying though.
